questions.question: Each of the students ___ required to submit a portfolio before Friday.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so it takes a singular verb: 'Each of the students is required...'

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Each, Every, Everyone)

description.en: Indefinite pronouns such as each, every, everyone, everybody, nobody, and somebody are grammatically singular, even when they are followed by 'of + plural noun'.
description.id: Kata ganti tak tentu seperti each, every, everyone, everybody, nobody, dan somebody bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal, meskipun diikuti oleh 'of + kata benda jamak'.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the students are required to submit a portfolio before Friday.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the students is required to submit a portfolio before Friday.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'Each', which is singular. The plural noun 'students' inside the prepositional phrase does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'Each' yang bersifat tunggal. Kata benda jamak 'students' di dalam frasa preposisi tidak menentukan bentuk kata kerja.

en.introduction: The subject of this sentence is 'Each of the students'. The grammatical head is 'Each', not 'students'. Since 'each' is always singular, the verb must also be singular.

rules.title: 1. Each and Every Are Always Singular
rules.explanation: The pronouns each and every take a singular verb, no matter how many people or things follow them.
rules.structure: Each / Every + singular verb: Each is..., Every one needs...
notes: 'Each of the students is' is correct.
'Each of the students are' is incorrect.

rules.title: 2. Ignore the Plural Noun After 'of'
rules.explanation: The phrase 'of + plural noun' only describes the group. It does not change the number of the real subject, which is 'each'.
rules.structure: Each + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The same rule applies to 'one of the students', 'every one of the players', and 'neither of the answers'.

common_mistakes.wrong: Each of the participants were given a form.
common_mistakes.correct: Each of the participants was given a form.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Each' is singular, so the verb must be 'was', not 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: Each of the rooms has its own bathroom.
other_examples.translation: Setiap kamar memiliki kamar mandinya sendiri.

explanation.en: 'Each' is singular, so the verb is 'has'. The plural noun 'rooms' does not affect the verb.
explanation.id: 'Each' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'. Kata benda jamak 'rooms' tidak memengaruhi kata kerja.

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ satisfied with the new schedule.
questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. The nearest subject is 'the employees' (plural), so the verb is 'were'.

description.en: When two subjects are joined by 'or' or 'nor', the verb agrees with the subject that is closest to it.
description.id: Ketika dua subjek digabungkan dengan 'or' atau 'nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither the manager nor the employees was satisfied with the new schedule.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither the manager nor the employees were satisfied with the new schedule.

explanation.en: The subject closest to the verb is 'the employees', which is plural, so 'were' is required.
explanation.id: Subjek yang paling dekat dengan kata kerja adalah 'the employees' yang berbentuk jamak, sehingga 'were' yang tepat.

en.introduction: This sentence uses the correlative conjunction pair 'neither ... nor'. With 'or' and 'nor', the verb does not simply become plural; it follows the subject that is closest to it.

rules.title: 1. The Proximity Rule
rules.explanation: In a sentence with 'or' or 'nor', look at the second subject, the one immediately before the verb. The verb agrees with that subject.
rules.structure: Either A or B + verb (agrees with B); Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the manager nor the employees were... (B is plural)
Neither the employees nor the manager was... (B is singular)

rules.title: 2. Do Not Simply Add the Two Subjects
rules.explanation: 'Neither ... nor' presents alternatives, not a combined group, so it does not automatically produce a plural verb.
rules.structure: Neither + singular + nor + plural + plural verb
notes: Compare with 'and', which always produces a plural subject.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the manager nor the employees was informed.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the manager nor the employees were informed.
common_mistakes.reason: The verb must match the nearest subject, 'the employees'.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the players nor the coach was available for comment.
other_examples.translation: Baik para pemain maupun pelatih tidak tersedia untuk memberikan komentar.

explanation.en: The nearest subject is 'the coach' (singular), so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat adalah 'the coach' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: The committee ___ reached its decision and will announce it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The collective noun 'committee' is treated as one single unit here, as shown by the pronoun 'its', so it takes the singular verb 'has'.

description.en: Collective nouns (committee, team, family, jury, government) take a singular verb when the group acts as one unit, and a plural verb when the members act individually.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif (committee, team, family, jury, government) memakai kata kerja tunggal bila kelompok bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan, dan kata kerja jamak bila anggotanya bertindak sendiri-sendiri.

wrong_correct.wrong: The committee have reached its decision and will announce it tomorrow.
wrong_correct.correct: The committee has reached its decision and will announce it tomorrow.

explanation.en: The pronoun 'its' signals that the committee is being viewed as one unit, so the singular verb 'has' is required.
explanation.id: Kata ganti 'its' menunjukkan bahwa committee dipandang sebagai satu kesatuan, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'has' yang diperlukan.

en.introduction: A collective noun names a group of people or things. Its verb can be singular or plural depending on whether the group is seen as a single unit or as a collection of individuals.

rules.title: 1. Group as One Unit = Singular Verb
rules.explanation: When the group acts together or is referred to with 'it' / 'its', use a singular verb.
rules.structure: The committee / team / family + singular verb + it / its
notes: The committee has decided...
The team is celebrating its victory.

rules.title: 2. Members Acting Individually = Plural Verb
rules.explanation: When the members are acting separately, or when the sentence uses 'they' or 'their', use a plural verb.
rules.structure: The committee / team / family + plural verb + they / their
notes: The committee are divided in their opinions.
The team were arguing among themselves.

common_mistakes.wrong: The jury has returned to their seats.
common_mistakes.correct: The jury have returned to their seats.
common_mistakes.reason: The pronoun 'their' shows that the members are acting individually, so a plural verb is needed.

other_examples.sentence: The government has announced its new policy.
other_examples.translation: Pemerintah telah mengumumkan kebijakan barunya.

explanation.en: 'Government' acts as one unit and is referred to by 'its', so the singular verb 'has' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Government' bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan dan dirujuk dengan 'its', sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'has' benar.

questions.question: The police ___ investigating the robbery that took place last night.
questions.explanation: 'Police' is a plural collective noun in English and always takes a plural verb: 'The police are investigating...'

description.en: Some collective nouns are always plural in English, notably 'police', 'people', and 'cattle'. They always take a plural verb.
description.id: Beberapa kata benda kolektif selalu berbentuk jamak dalam bahasa Inggris, terutama 'police', 'people', dan 'cattle'. Kata kerja yang dipakai selalu jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: The police is investigating the robbery that took place last night.
wrong_correct.correct: The police are investigating the robbery that took place last night.

explanation.en: 'Police' has no singular form in this sense and is always treated as plural in English.
explanation.id: 'Police' tidak memiliki bentuk tunggal dalam makna ini dan selalu dianggap jamak dalam bahasa Inggris.

en.introduction: 'Police' refers to the members of a police force as a group of individuals. Unlike 'team' or 'committee', it has no singular interpretation, so it always takes a plural verb.

rules.title: 1. Always-Plural Nouns
rules.explanation: A small group of nouns is always plural: police, people, cattle, and clothes.
rules.structure: The police / people / cattle + plural verb
notes: The police are coming.
People are waiting outside.
Cattle are grazing in the field.

rules.title: 2. Singular Alternatives
rules.explanation: If you need a singular subject, use a different word such as 'policeman', 'police officer', or 'a member of the police force'.
rules.structure: A police officer + singular verb
notes: A police officer is investigating the case.

common_mistakes.wrong: The police has arrested the suspect.
common_mistakes.correct: The police have arrested the suspect.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Police' is always plural, so it requires 'have', not 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: The people in the village are very friendly.
other_examples.translation: Orang-orang di desa itu sangat ramah.

explanation.en: 'People' is plural and takes the plural verb 'are'.
explanation.id: 'People' bersifat jamak dan memakai kata kerja jamak 'are'.

questions.question: Everyone in both villages ___ aware of the new regulation.
questions.explanation: 'Everyone' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so it takes the singular verb 'is', even though it refers to many people.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Everyone, Everybody, Somebody)

description.en: Pronouns ending in -one, -body, and -thing (everyone, everybody, everything, nobody, something) are grammatically singular.
description.id: Kata ganti berakhiran -one, -body, dan -thing (everyone, everybody, everything, nobody, something) bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Everyone in both villages are aware of the new regulation.
wrong_correct.correct: Everyone in both villages is aware of the new regulation.

explanation.en: 'Everyone' is singular; the plural phrase 'in both villages' is only a prepositional modifier and does not change the verb.
explanation.id: 'Everyone' bersifat tunggal; frasa jamak 'in both villages' hanya keterangan preposisi dan tidak mengubah kata kerja.

en.introduction: In English, 'everyone' means 'every person', but grammatically it is treated as one singular unit. That is why it takes a singular verb.

rules.title: 1. -One and -Body Pronouns Are Singular
rules.explanation: Everyone, everybody, someone, somebody, anyone, anybody, no one, and nobody all take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Everyone / Everybody / Nobody + singular verb
notes: Everyone is here.
Nobody knows the answer.

rules.title: 2. Prepositional Phrases Do Not Change the Subject
rules.explanation: A phrase beginning with 'in', 'at', 'of', or 'with' describes the subject but does not change whether it is singular or plural.
rules.structure: Everyone + (prepositional phrase) + singular verb
notes: 'In both villages' is a modifier, not part of the grammatical subject.

common_mistakes.wrong: Everybody in the class have finished the test.
common_mistakes.correct: Everybody in the class has finished the test.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Everybody' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: Nobody in the office knows where the file is.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada seorang pun di kantor yang tahu di mana berkas itu.

explanation.en: 'Nobody' is singular and takes the singular verb 'knows'.
explanation.id: 'Nobody' bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal 'knows'.

questions.question: The number of applicants ___ significantly this year.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' is the subject and it is singular, so the verb must be singular: 'The number ... has increased'.

subtopic.en: Quantity Expressions (The number of / A number of)
subtopic.id: Ungkapan Jumlah (The number of / A number of)

description.en: 'The number of + plural noun' is singular because the head noun is 'number'. 'A number of + plural noun' is plural because it means 'several'.
description.id: 'The number of + kata benda jamak' bersifat tunggal karena inti subjeknya adalah 'number'. 'A number of + kata benda jamak' bersifat jamak karena berarti 'beberapa'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The number of applicants have increased significantly this year.
wrong_correct.correct: The number of applicants has increased significantly this year.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is the singular noun 'number', so the verb must be 'has increased'.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah kata benda tunggal 'number', sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has increased'.

en.introduction: These two expressions look almost identical, but they have opposite grammatical effects. 'The number of' focuses on one figure; 'a number of' means 'several'.

rules.title: 1. The Number Of = Singular
rules.explanation: Here 'number' is the real subject, so the verb is singular.
rules.structure: The number of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The number of students is growing.
The number of cars has doubled.

rules.title: 2. A Number Of = Plural
rules.explanation: 'A number of' functions like 'several' or 'many', so it takes a plural verb.
rules.structure: A number of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: A number of students are absent today.
A number of problems have been reported.

common_mistakes.wrong: A number of students has complained.
common_mistakes.correct: A number of students have complained.
common_mistakes.reason: 'A number of' means 'several', so the plural verb 'have' is needed.

other_examples.sentence: A number of volunteers have signed up for the programme.
other_examples.translation: Sejumlah relawan telah mendaftar untuk program tersebut.

explanation.en: 'A number of' behaves like 'several', so the plural verb 'have signed up' is correct.
explanation.id: 'A number of' berperilaku seperti 'beberapa', sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have signed up' benar.

questions.question: A number of students ___ expressed interest in the exchange programme.
questions.explanation: 'A number of' means 'several', so it takes a plural verb: 'A number of students have expressed...'

subtopic.en: Quantity Expressions (The number of / A number of)
subtopic.id: Ungkapan Jumlah (The number of / A number of)

description.en: 'A number of + plural noun' functions as a plural subject and takes a plural verb.
description.id: 'A number of + kata benda jamak' berfungsi sebagai subjek jamak dan memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: A number of students has expressed interest in the exchange programme.
wrong_correct.correct: A number of students have expressed interest in the exchange programme.

explanation.en: 'A number of' is a quantifier meaning 'several', so the plural verb 'have' is required.
explanation.id: 'A number of' adalah pembilang yang berarti 'beberapa', sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have' diperlukan.

en.introduction: Compare 'a number of' with 'the number of'. Here the article 'a' signals the meaning 'several', so the sentence behaves like 'Several students have expressed interest'.

rules.title: 1. A Number Of = Several
rules.explanation: This phrase is a quantifier, not the subject itself. The plural noun after it controls the verb.
rules.structure: A number of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: A number of books were missing.
A number of people have complained.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with The Number Of
rules.explanation: 'The number of' focuses on a single figure and is singular, while 'a number of' focuses on the individual items and is plural.
rules.structure: The number of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The number of books was surprising.

common_mistakes.wrong: A number of issues has been raised.
common_mistakes.correct: A number of issues have been raised.
common_mistakes.reason: 'A number of' behaves like 'several' and needs a plural verb.

other_examples.sentence: A number of shops in the mall were closed yesterday.
other_examples.translation: Sejumlah toko di mal itu tutup kemarin.

explanation.en: 'A number of shops' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: 'A number of shops' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: Either of the two candidates ___ acceptable to the board.
questions.explanation: 'Either' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so it takes a singular verb: 'Either of the two candidates is acceptable'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Either, Neither, None)

description.en: In formal English, 'either of' and 'neither of' are treated as singular subjects and take singular verbs.
description.id: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal, 'either of' dan 'neither of' dianggap subjek tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Either of the two candidates are acceptable to the board.
wrong_correct.correct: Either of the two candidates is acceptable to the board.

explanation.en: 'Either' means 'one or the other' and is singular, so the verb must be 'is'.
explanation.id: 'Either' berarti 'salah satu dari dua' dan bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'is'.

en.introduction: 'Either of' refers to one item chosen from two. Because it picks out a single item, the subject is grammatically singular.

rules.title: 1. Either / Neither + of + Plural Noun
rules.explanation: Even though a plural noun follows 'of', the head word 'either' or 'neither' controls the verb in formal writing.
rules.structure: Either / Neither + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Either of the answers is correct.
Neither of the plans was approved.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with Both
rules.explanation: 'Both of' refers to two items together, so it takes a plural verb.
rules.structure: Both of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: Both of the candidates are acceptable.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither of the students have finished.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither of the students has finished.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Neither of' is treated as singular in formal English.

other_examples.sentence: Either of the routes leads to the same beach.
other_examples.translation: Salah satu dari kedua rute itu menuju pantai yang sama.

explanation.en: 'Either of' is singular, so the verb is 'leads'.
explanation.id: 'Either of' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'leads'.

questions.question: The teacher, along with her students, ___ attending the opening ceremony.
questions.explanation: 'Along with her students' is an interrupting phrase, not part of the subject. The real subject is 'The teacher', which is singular.

description.en: Phrases such as 'along with', 'together with', 'as well as', and 'accompanied by' add extra information but do not change the number of the subject.
description.id: Frasa seperti 'along with', 'together with', 'as well as', dan 'accompanied by' menambah informasi tetapi tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

wrong_correct.wrong: The teacher, along with her students, are attending the opening ceremony.
wrong_correct.correct: The teacher, along with her students, is attending the opening ceremony.

explanation.en: 'Along with' is not the conjunction 'and'. The subject remains 'The teacher', which is singular.
explanation.id: 'Along with' bukan konjungsi 'and'. Subjeknya tetap 'The teacher' yang bersifat tunggal.

en.introduction: Some phrases look like they join two subjects, but they do not. They only add extra information about the first subject, so the verb still agrees with the first subject.

rules.title: 1. Phrases That Do Not Change the Subject
rules.explanation: Along with, together with, as well as, accompanied by, including, and in addition to are not conjunctions. They do not make the subject plural.
rules.structure: Singular subject + , along with / as well as + phrase, + singular verb
notes: The teacher, as well as the students, is coming.
The mayor, together with his advisors, was present.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with And
rules.explanation: Only 'and' truly joins two subjects into a plural one.
rules.structure: Subject A + and + Subject B + plural verb
notes: The teacher and her students are attending the ceremony.

common_mistakes.wrong: The manager, as well as the employees, were surprised.
common_mistakes.correct: The manager, as well as the employees, was surprised.
common_mistakes.reason: 'As well as' does not join the subjects; the singular 'manager' controls the verb.

other_examples.sentence: The president, accompanied by his ministers, has arrived at the venue.
other_examples.translation: Presiden, didampingi para menterinya, telah tiba di lokasi.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The president' (singular); 'accompanied by his ministers' is only an interrupting phrase.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The president' (tunggal); 'accompanied by his ministers' hanya frasa penyela.

questions.question: The books on the top shelf ___ to the school library.
questions.explanation: The subject is 'The books' (plural). 'On the top shelf' is only a prepositional phrase, so the verb must be plural: 'belong'.

description.en: A prepositional phrase placed between the subject and the verb does not change the number of the subject.
description.id: Frasa preposisi yang terletak di antara subjek dan kata kerja tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

wrong_correct.wrong: The books on the top shelf belongs to the school library.
wrong_correct.correct: The books on the top shelf belong to the school library.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'books' (plural). The singular noun 'shelf' is inside a prepositional phrase and cannot control the verb.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'books' (jamak). Kata benda tunggal 'shelf' berada di dalam frasa preposisi dan tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: Long subjects often contain a prepositional phrase. The verb must agree with the main noun, not with the noun closest to the verb.

rules.title: 1. Find the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Cross out the prepositional phrase and ask 'Who or what is doing the action?' The answer is the head noun.
rules.structure: Head noun + (prepositional phrase) + verb
notes: The books (on the top shelf) belong...
The bouquet (of roses) smells wonderful.

rules.title: 2. Common Prepositions That Create Interruptions
rules.explanation: Watch for of, on, in, at, with, from, by, and about between the subject and the verb.
rules.structure: Subject + of / on / in / with + noun + verb
notes: The colour of the walls is unusual.
The students in the front row were attentive.

common_mistakes.wrong: The bouquet of roses smell wonderful.
common_mistakes.correct: The bouquet of roses smells wonderful.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun is 'bouquet' (singular); 'of roses' is only a modifier.

other_examples.sentence: The keys to the office are kept in the drawer.
other_examples.translation: Kunci-kunci kantor disimpan di dalam laci.

explanation.en: The head noun 'keys' is plural, so the verb is 'are'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'keys' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'are'.

questions.question: My brother and I ___ planning to apply for the police academy.
questions.explanation: Two subjects joined by 'and' form a plural subject, so the verb is 'are': 'My brother and I are planning...'

description.en: Two or more subjects joined by 'and' normally form a plural subject and take a plural verb.
description.id: Dua subjek atau lebih yang digabungkan dengan 'and' umumnya membentuk subjek jamak dan memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: My brother and I is planning to apply for the police academy.
wrong_correct.correct: My brother and I are planning to apply for the police academy.

explanation.en: 'My brother and I' means two people, so the plural verb 'are' is needed. Note that the polite order puts 'I' last.
explanation.id: 'My brother and I' berarti dua orang, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'are' diperlukan. Perhatikan bahwa urutan yang sopan menempatkan 'I' di akhir.

en.introduction: When 'and' joins two different people or things, the subject becomes plural and takes a plural verb. This is different from 'or' and 'nor', which follow the proximity rule.

rules.title: 1. And = Plural Subject
rules.explanation: Compound subjects joined by 'and' take a plural verb, even if each individual subject is singular.
rules.structure: Subject A + and + Subject B + plural verb
notes: The teacher and the principal are here.
My sister and my cousin have arrived.

rules.title: 2. Special Case: One Single Idea
rules.explanation: If two nouns joined by 'and' describe one single person, thing, or idea, the verb is singular.
rules.structure: Bread and butter is...; The chairman and founder has...
notes: Bread and butter is a simple breakfast.
Rice and fish is a typical meal.

common_mistakes.wrong: My mother and my aunt is coming tonight.
common_mistakes.correct: My mother and my aunt are coming tonight.
common_mistakes.reason: Two people joined by 'and' make a plural subject.

other_examples.sentence: The manager and the supervisor have signed the document.
other_examples.translation: Manajer dan pengawas telah menandatangani dokumen tersebut.

explanation.en: Two different people joined by 'and' form a plural subject, so 'have' is correct.
explanation.id: Dua orang berbeda yang digabungkan dengan 'and' membentuk subjek jamak, sehingga 'have' benar.

questions.question: Bread and butter ___ his usual breakfast.
questions.explanation: 'Bread and butter' describes one single meal, so it is treated as singular and takes 'is'.

description.en: When two nouns joined by 'and' express a single idea, a single person, or a single dish, the verb is singular.
description.id: Ketika dua kata benda yang digabungkan dengan 'and' menyatakan satu gagasan, satu orang, atau satu hidangan, kata kerjanya tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Bread and butter are his usual breakfast.
wrong_correct.correct: Bread and butter is his usual breakfast.

explanation.en: The two nouns describe one combined dish, so the subject is treated as singular.
explanation.id: Kedua kata benda itu menggambarkan satu hidangan gabungan, sehingga subjeknya dianggap tunggal.

en.introduction: Normally 'and' creates a plural subject. However, some fixed pairs of nouns refer to one combined thing, and these take a singular verb.

rules.title: 1. Fixed Pairs Treated as One Unit
rules.explanation: Expressions like 'bread and butter', 'rice and fish', and 'salt and pepper' often describe one item or one dish.
rules.structure: Noun + and + noun (one idea) + singular verb
notes: Bread and butter is delicious.
Rice and chicken is my favourite meal.

rules.title: 2. Check the Meaning, Not Only the Conjunction
rules.explanation: If the two nouns clearly refer to separate things, use a plural verb. If they form one idea, use a singular verb.
rules.structure: Two separate things + plural verb; one combined idea + singular verb
notes: The bread and the butter are on the table. (two separate things)

common_mistakes.wrong: Bread and butter are all he eats for breakfast.
common_mistakes.correct: Bread and butter is all he eats for breakfast.
common_mistakes.reason: The pair names one dish, so the subject is singular.

other_examples.sentence: Fish and chips is a popular British dish.
other_examples.translation: Fish and chips adalah hidangan Inggris yang populer.

explanation.en: 'Fish and chips' names one dish, so the singular verb 'is' is used.
explanation.id: 'Fish and chips' menamai satu hidangan, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'is' digunakan.

questions.question: The Philippines ___ located in Southeast Asia.
questions.explanation: The Philippines is the name of one country, so it takes a singular verb: 'The Philippines is located in Southeast Asia.'

subtopic.id: Subjek Tunggal dan Jamak (Kata Benda Khusus)

description.en: Some nouns end in -s but name a single thing, for example country names like the Philippines and the Netherlands, and subjects like mathematics and news. These take singular verbs.
description.id: Beberapa kata benda berakhiran -s tetapi menamai satu hal, misalnya nama negara seperti the Philippines dan the Netherlands, serta mata pelajaran seperti mathematics dan news. Kata kerja yang dipakai tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: The Philippines are located in Southeast Asia.
wrong_correct.correct: The Philippines is located in Southeast Asia.

explanation.en: Although the name ends in -s, it refers to one country, so the verb is singular.
explanation.id: Meskipun namanya berakhiran -s, nama itu merujuk pada satu negara, sehingga kata kerjanya tunggal.

en.introduction: Do not judge number only by the final letter of a noun. Several nouns end in -s but are grammatically singular.

rules.title: 1. Country and Title Names
rules.explanation: Names such as the Philippines, the Netherlands, and the United States are singular because each names one country.
rules.structure: The Philippines / the Netherlands / the United States + singular verb
notes: The Netherlands is famous for its canals.
The United States has fifty states.

rules.title: 2. Other -s Nouns That Are Singular
rules.explanation: Academic subjects and some common nouns also end in -s but take singular verbs: mathematics, physics, economics, news.
rules.structure: Mathematics / Physics / News + singular verb
notes: Mathematics is difficult.
The news is good.

common_mistakes.wrong: The news are very surprising.
common_mistakes.correct: The news is very surprising.
common_mistakes.reason: 'News' is an uncountable singular noun despite ending in -s.

other_examples.sentence: The United States has a new president.
other_examples.translation: Amerika Serikat memiliki presiden baru.

explanation.en: The country name is singular in grammar, so the verb is 'has'.
explanation.id: Nama negara itu tunggal secara gramatikal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'.

questions.question: Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk in one day.
questions.explanation: A measurement of distance is treated as one single amount, so it takes a singular verb: 'Ten kilometres is a long distance.'

description.en: Expressions of distance, weight, time, and money are treated as a single amount and take a singular verb.
description.id: Ungkapan jarak, berat, waktu, dan uang dianggap sebagai satu jumlah dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Ten kilometres are a long distance to walk in one day.
wrong_correct.correct: Ten kilometres is a long distance to walk in one day.

explanation.en: The phrase names one total distance, not ten separate kilometres, so the verb must be singular.
explanation.id: Frasa itu menamai satu jarak total, bukan sepuluh kilometer terpisah, sehingga kata kerjanya harus tunggal.

en.introduction: When a number and a unit of measurement form one amount, the whole expression is singular in grammar.

rules.title: 1. One Amount = Singular Verb
rules.explanation: Distance, weight, time, and money expressions are considered one unit.
rules.structure: Number + unit + singular verb
notes: Ten kilometres is far.
Fifty kilograms is too heavy.
Two hours is enough.

rules.title: 2. When the Items Are Separate
rules.explanation: If you are talking about separate individual items rather than one amount, use a plural verb.
rules.structure: Number + plural noun (separate items) + plural verb
notes: Ten kilometres were marked on the map. (ten separate stretches)

common_mistakes.wrong: Twenty dollars are too much for a cup of coffee.
common_mistakes.correct: Twenty dollars is too much for a cup of coffee.
common_mistakes.reason: Money is treated as one amount, so the verb is singular.

other_examples.sentence: Three hours is not enough to finish the exam.
other_examples.translation: Tiga jam tidak cukup untuk menyelesaikan ujian itu.

explanation.en: 'Three hours' is one period of time, so the singular verb 'is' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Three hours' adalah satu rentang waktu, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'is' benar.

questions.question: Some of the water ___ spilled on the floor during the experiment.
questions.explanation: With 'some of', the verb agrees with the noun after 'of'. 'Water' is uncountable and singular, so the verb is 'was'.

description.en: With quantifiers such as some of, most of, all of, half of, and none of, the verb agrees with the noun that follows 'of'.
description.id: Dengan pembilang seperti some of, most of, all of, half of, dan none of, kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of'.

wrong_correct.wrong: Some of the water were spilled on the floor during the experiment.
wrong_correct.correct: Some of the water was spilled on the floor during the experiment.

explanation.en: 'Water' is an uncountable noun, so it is singular and requires 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Water' adalah kata benda tak terhitung, sehingga bersifat tunggal dan memerlukan 'was'.

en.introduction: Quantifiers like 'some of' are not the real subject. They point to a noun after 'of', and that noun decides whether the verb is singular or plural.

rules.title: 1. Look at the Noun After Of
rules.explanation: Uncountable nouns (water, money, information) and singular nouns take singular verbs; plural nouns take plural verbs.
rules.structure: Some / Most / All / Half / None + of + noun + verb (agrees with noun)
notes: Some of the water was spilled. (uncountable)
Some of the students were late. (plural)

rules.title: 2. Uncountable Nouns Are Always Singular
rules.explanation: Nouns such as water, money, advice, furniture, and information have no plural form in this sense.
rules.structure: Uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: The furniture is new.
The information was useful.

common_mistakes.wrong: Most of the furniture were damaged.
common_mistakes.correct: Most of the furniture was damaged.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Furniture' is uncountable and singular, so the verb must be 'was'.

other_examples.sentence: Some of the cake was left on the plate.
other_examples.translation: Sebagian kue itu tersisa di piring.

explanation.en: 'Cake' is uncountable here, so the verb is singular: 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Cake' bersifat tak terhitung di sini, sehingga kata kerjanya tunggal: 'was'.

questions.question: Most of the students in the advanced class ___ passed the examination.
questions.explanation: The noun after 'of' is 'students' (plural), so the verb must be plural: 'Most of the students ... have passed'.

description.en: With 'most of', 'some of', and 'all of', the verb agrees with the noun that follows the preposition 'of'.
description.id: Dengan 'most of', 'some of', dan 'all of', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah preposisi 'of'.

wrong_correct.wrong: Most of the students in the advanced class has passed the examination.
wrong_correct.correct: Most of the students in the advanced class have passed the examination.

explanation.en: The noun after 'of' is the plural 'students', so the plural verb 'have' is required.
explanation.id: Kata benda setelah 'of' adalah 'students' yang jamak, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have' diperlukan.

en.introduction: 'Most of' is a quantifier, not the grammatical subject. The subject is the noun after 'of', which here is the plural noun 'students'.

rules.title: 1. The Noun After Of Controls the Verb
rules.explanation: Plural countable nouns take plural verbs; singular or uncountable nouns take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Most of + plural noun + plural verb; Most of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: Most of the students have passed.
Most of the water has evaporated.

rules.title: 2. Beware of Extra Phrases
rules.explanation: Phrases such as 'in the advanced class' sit between the subject and the verb but do not affect agreement.
rules.structure: Most of + noun + (extra phrase) + verb
notes: The extra phrase 'in the advanced class' is a modifier only.

common_mistakes.wrong: All of the players was tired.
common_mistakes.correct: All of the players were tired.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Players' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: Some of the letters have not been answered yet.
other_examples.translation: Sebagian surat belum dijawab.

explanation.en: 'Letters' is plural, so the plural verb 'have' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Letters' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have' benar.

questions.question: All of the information in the report ___ confidential.
questions.explanation: 'Information' is an uncountable noun, so the verb after 'all of' must be singular: 'All of the information ... is confidential'.

description.en: Uncountable nouns such as information, advice, furniture, and equipment are grammatically singular even after quantifiers like 'all of'.
description.id: Kata benda tak terhitung seperti information, advice, furniture, dan equipment bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal bahkan setelah pembilang seperti 'all of'.

wrong_correct.wrong: All of the information in the report are confidential.
wrong_correct.correct: All of the information in the report is confidential.

explanation.en: 'Information' has no plural form and is treated as singular, so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.id: 'Information' tidak memiliki bentuk jamak dan dianggap tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'is'.

en.introduction: English uncountable nouns do not take -s and are always singular in grammar. They include information, advice, news, furniture, equipment, luggage, and homework.

rules.title: 1. Uncountable Nouns Take Singular Verbs
rules.explanation: Even when a quantifier such as 'all of', 'some of', or 'most of' comes before them, uncountable nouns keep a singular verb.
rules.structure: All of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: All of the information is correct.
All of the equipment was replaced.

rules.title: 2. No Plural -s on Uncountable Nouns
rules.explanation: Do not write 'informations', 'advices', 'furnitures', or 'equipments'.
rules.structure: Uncountable noun (no -s)
notes: Correct: a piece of information.
Incorrect: an information.

common_mistakes.wrong: The equipments are new.
common_mistakes.correct: The equipment is new.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Equipment' is uncountable and takes a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: All of the homework has been submitted.
other_examples.translation: Semua pekerjaan rumah telah dikumpulkan.

explanation.en: 'Homework' is uncountable, so the singular verb 'has' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Homework' bersifat tak terhitung, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'has' benar.

questions.question: The jury ___ reached its verdict after three hours of deliberation.
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'its' shows that the jury is treated as one unit, so the singular verb 'has' is required.

description.en: Collective nouns such as jury, committee, team, and family take a singular verb when the group acts as a single unit.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif seperti jury, committee, team, dan family memakai kata kerja tunggal ketika kelompok bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan.

wrong_correct.wrong: The jury have reached its verdict after three hours of deliberation.
wrong_correct.correct: The jury has reached its verdict after three hours of deliberation.

explanation.en: 'Its' is singular, so the verb must also be singular: 'has'.
explanation.id: 'Its' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya juga harus tunggal: 'has'.

en.introduction: In English, collective nouns can be singular or plural depending on how the group is viewed. Pronouns in the sentence are a strong clue.

rules.title: 1. Look for the Pronoun Clue
rules.explanation: If the sentence uses 'it' or 'its', the group is a single unit and the verb must be singular.
rules.structure: Collective noun + singular verb + it / its
notes: The jury has reached its verdict.
The company has changed its policy.

rules.title: 2. Look for 'They' or 'Their'
rules.explanation: If the sentence uses 'they' or 'their', the members are viewed individually and the verb must be plural.
rules.structure: Collective noun + plural verb + they / their
notes: The jury were divided in their opinions.

common_mistakes.wrong: The committee have made its final decision.
common_mistakes.correct: The committee has made its final decision.
common_mistakes.reason: The singular pronoun 'its' requires a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: The team has won its third championship.
other_examples.translation: Tim itu telah memenangkan kejuaraan ketiganya.

explanation.en: 'The team' acts as one unit and is referred to by 'its', so the verb is singular.
explanation.id: 'The team' bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan dan dirujuk dengan 'its', sehingga kata kerjanya tunggal.

questions.question: The jury ___ still arguing among themselves when the judge entered the courtroom.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'among themselves' shows the jurors are acting as individuals, so the plural verb 'were' is required.

description.en: When members of a group act individually, the collective noun takes a plural verb, often signalled by 'they', 'their', or 'themselves'.
description.id: Ketika anggota suatu kelompok bertindak sendiri-sendiri, kata benda kolektif memakai kata kerja jamak, sering ditandai oleh 'they', 'their', atau 'themselves'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The jury was still arguing among themselves when the judge entered the courtroom.
wrong_correct.correct: The jury were still arguing among themselves when the judge entered the courtroom.

explanation.en: 'Themselves' is plural, so the verb must also be plural.
explanation.id: 'Themselves' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya juga harus jamak.

en.introduction: When a collective noun refers to members who disagree, argue, or act separately, English treats the group as plural.

rules.title: 1. Signals of Individual Action
rules.explanation: Words such as 'themselves', 'their', 'among themselves', and 'divided' indicate that the members are being viewed separately.
rules.structure: Collective noun + plural verb + themselves / their
notes: The jury were arguing among themselves.
The committee are divided in their opinions.

rules.title: 2. Keep the Sentence Consistent
rules.explanation: Once you choose a plural verb for a collective noun, keep the pronouns plural too.
rules.structure: Plural verb + they / their / themselves
notes: Correct: The jury were... among themselves.
Incorrect: The jury was... among themselves.

common_mistakes.wrong: The team was putting on their jackets.
common_mistakes.correct: The team were putting on their jackets.
common_mistakes.reason: The plural pronoun 'their' signals individual action, so the verb should be plural.

other_examples.sentence: The committee are still arguing among themselves about the budget.
other_examples.translation: Komite itu masih berdebat di antara mereka sendiri tentang anggaran.

explanation.en: 'Among themselves' shows individual action, so the plural verb 'are' is used.
explanation.id: 'Among themselves' menunjukkan tindakan individual, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'are' digunakan.

questions.question: One of my classmates ___ been selected for the national debate team.
questions.explanation: 'One of' is the head of the subject and is singular, so the verb is 'has': 'One of my classmates has been selected'.

subtopic.en: Indefinite Pronouns (One of, Each of, Neither of)
subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (One of, Each of, Neither of)

description.en: 'One of + plural noun' is a singular subject because 'one' is the head word.
description.id: 'One of + kata benda jamak' adalah subjek tunggal karena inti katanya adalah 'one'.

wrong_correct.wrong: One of my classmates have been selected for the national debate team.
wrong_correct.correct: One of my classmates has been selected for the national debate team.

explanation.en: The subject is 'one', not 'classmates', so the singular verb 'has' is correct.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'one', bukan 'classmates', sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'has' yang benar.

en.introduction: The pattern 'one of + plural noun' is very common in exams. The verb agrees with 'one', not with the plural noun that follows.

rules.title: 1. One Of = Singular
rules.explanation: Even though many people are mentioned, the sentence talks about only one of them.
rules.structure: One of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: One of the boys is missing.
One of my friends has moved abroad.

rules.title: 2. The Same Rule for Each Of and Neither Of
rules.explanation: These expressions follow the same pattern and take singular verbs in formal English.
rules.structure: Each of / Neither of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the rooms has a window.
Neither of the answers is correct.

common_mistakes.wrong: One of the students have won a prize.
common_mistakes.correct: One of the students has won a prize.
common_mistakes.reason: The subject 'one' is singular, so the verb must be 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: One of the windows is broken.
other_examples.translation: Salah satu jendela rusak.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'one' (singular), so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'one' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya 'is'.

questions.question: The quality of these imported products ___ improved noticeably.
questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'quality' (singular). 'Of these imported products' is only a modifier, so the verb is 'has'.

description.en: The verb agrees with the head noun of the subject, not with a noun inside an 'of' phrase.
description.id: Kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan inti subjek, bukan dengan kata benda di dalam frasa 'of'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The quality of these imported products have improved noticeably.
wrong_correct.correct: The quality of these imported products has improved noticeably.

explanation.en: The subject is 'the quality' (singular); 'of these imported products' is a prepositional phrase that does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'the quality' (tunggal); 'of these imported products' adalah frasa preposisi yang tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: This is one of the most common traps in subject-verb agreement tests. The verb agrees with the first noun, even when a plural noun appears right before the verb.

rules.title: 1. Identify the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Ask 'What has improved?' The answer is 'the quality', which is singular.
rules.structure: Head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The quality of the products has improved.
The price of these shoes is too high.

rules.title: 2. Common Head Nouns in This Pattern
rules.explanation: Words like quality, number, price, level, amount, and standard are singular and often followed by 'of + plural noun'.
rules.structure: Singular head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The level of pollution has risen.
The amount of money was insufficient.

common_mistakes.wrong: The price of these houses are very high.
common_mistakes.correct: The price of these houses is very high.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun is 'price' (singular), not 'houses'.

other_examples.sentence: The standard of living in these cities has risen.
other_examples.translation: Standar hidup di kota-kota ini telah meningkat.

explanation.en: The head noun 'standard' is singular, so the verb is 'has risen'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'standard' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has risen'.

questions.question: There ___ two books and a pen on the desk.
questions.explanation: In a 'there is / there are' sentence, the verb agrees with the noun that follows. 'Two books' is plural, so 'are' is correct.

description.en: In sentences beginning with 'there', the real subject comes after the verb, so the verb agrees with the noun that follows it.
description.id: Dalam kalimat yang diawali 'there', subjek sebenarnya berada setelah kata kerja, sehingga kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda yang mengikutinya.

wrong_correct.wrong: There is two books and a pen on the desk.
wrong_correct.correct: There are two books and a pen on the desk.

explanation.en: 'Two books' is plural and comes first after the verb, so 'are' is needed.
explanation.id: 'Two books' bersifat jamak dan muncul pertama setelah kata kerja, sehingga 'are' diperlukan.

en.introduction: 'There' is not the subject of the sentence; it only introduces the existence of something. The real subject follows the verb.

rules.title: 1. The Verb Agrees with the Noun After It
rules.explanation: If the noun after the verb is plural, use 'are' or 'were'. If it is singular or uncountable, use 'is' or 'was'.
rules.structure: There + is / are + noun + place
notes: There are two books on the desk.
There is a pen on the desk.

rules.title: 2. When There Is More Than One Noun
rules.explanation: In formal English, the verb usually agrees with the first noun in the list.
rules.structure: There + verb + first noun + and + second noun
notes: There are two books and a pen...
There is a pen and two books...

common_mistakes.wrong: There was many people at the concert.
common_mistakes.correct: There were many people at the concert.
common_mistakes.reason: 'People' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: There are several problems with this plan.
other_examples.translation: Ada beberapa masalah dengan rencana ini.

explanation.en: The real subject 'several problems' is plural, so 'are' is correct.
explanation.id: Subjek sebenarnya 'several problems' bersifat jamak, sehingga 'are' benar.

questions.question: Not only the students but also the teacher ___ surprised by the announcement.
questions.explanation: With 'not only ... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. The nearest subject is 'the teacher' (singular), so 'was' is correct.

description.en: With correlative conjunctions such as 'not only ... but also', 'either ... or', and 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject.
description.id: Dengan konjungsi korelatif seperti 'not only ... but also', 'either ... or', dan 'neither ... nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang lebih dekat.

wrong_correct.wrong: Not only the students but also the teacher were surprised by the announcement.
wrong_correct.correct: Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised by the announcement.

explanation.en: The subject nearest the verb is 'the teacher' (singular), so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat dengan kata kerja adalah 'the teacher' (tunggal), sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: Correlative conjunctions link two subjects, but unlike 'and' they do not simply create a plural subject. The verb follows the second, closer subject.

rules.title: 1. The Proximity Rule Again
rules.explanation: Look at the subject after 'but also', 'or', or 'nor'. That subject decides the verb form.
rules.structure: Not only A but also B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Not only the students but also the teacher was...
Not only the teacher but also the students were...

rules.title: 2. Keep the Sentence Balanced
rules.explanation: The words after each part of the pair should have the same grammatical form, but the verb still follows the closer subject.
rules.structure: Not only + noun + but also + noun + verb
notes: Both versions are correct; only the verb changes.

common_mistakes.wrong: Not only the manager but also the staff members was informed.
common_mistakes.correct: Not only the manager but also the staff members were informed.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearest subject 'staff members' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: Not only the coach but also the players were disappointed.
other_examples.translation: Tidak hanya pelatih tetapi juga para pemain kecewa.

explanation.en: The closer subject 'the players' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek yang lebih dekat, 'the players', bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: Neither my parents nor my younger sister ___ able to attend the ceremony.
questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. 'My younger sister' is singular, so the verb is 'is'.

description.en: When subjects are joined by 'nor', the verb agrees with the subject closer to it.
description.id: Ketika subjek digabungkan dengan 'nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang lebih dekat.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither my parents nor my younger sister are able to attend the ceremony.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither my parents nor my younger sister is able to attend the ceremony.

explanation.en: The nearest subject 'my younger sister' is singular, so the singular verb 'is' is required.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'my younger sister' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'is' diperlukan.

en.introduction: Here the order of the subjects matters. The second subject, placed right before the verb, controls the agreement.

rules.title: 1. Match the Second Subject
rules.explanation: Ignore the first subject for agreement purposes and check only the one immediately before the verb.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither my parents nor my sister is...
Neither my sister nor my parents are...

rules.title: 2. Rewrite if It Sounds Awkward
rules.explanation: If the mixed pattern feels unnatural, rewrite the sentence with two separate clauses.
rules.structure: Neither of them + plural verb; or two separate sentences
notes: Neither my parents nor my sister was able to attend.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the driver nor the passengers was hurt.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the driver nor the passengers were hurt.
common_mistakes.reason: The closer subject 'the passengers' is plural.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the students nor the teacher was in the room.
other_examples.translation: Baik para siswa maupun guru tidak ada di ruangan.

explanation.en: The nearest subject 'the teacher' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'the teacher' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: The senator, together with his aides, ___ arriving at the airport tonight.
questions.explanation: 'Together with his aides' is an interrupting phrase. The real subject is 'The senator' (singular), so the verb is 'is'.

description.en: Phrases beginning with 'together with', 'along with', 'as well as', and 'in addition to' are parenthetical and do not change the number of the subject.
description.id: Frasa yang diawali 'together with', 'along with', 'as well as', dan 'in addition to' bersifat sisipan dan tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

wrong_correct.wrong: The senator, together with his aides, are arriving at the airport tonight.
wrong_correct.correct: The senator, together with his aides, is arriving at the airport tonight.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The senator'. The phrase 'together with his aides' is enclosed in commas and does not make the subject plural.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The senator'. Frasa 'together with his aides' diapit koma dan tidak membuat subjek menjadi jamak.

en.introduction: Parenthetical phrases are set off by commas and can be removed without changing the grammar of the sentence. The verb agrees with the subject that remains.

rules.title: 1. Remove the Phrase to Test
rules.explanation: Delete the phrase in commas and read the sentence again. That shows the true subject.
rules.structure: Subject + , together with + phrase, + verb
notes: The senator ... is arriving.
The senator, together with his aides, is arriving.

rules.title: 2. Compare with And
rules.explanation: 'The senator and his aides' (without commas) is a plural subject, but 'together with' is not a conjunction.
rules.structure: Subject A + and + Subject B + plural verb
notes: The senator and his aides are arriving.

common_mistakes.wrong: The CEO, together with the managers, were present.
common_mistakes.correct: The CEO, together with the managers, was present.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Together with' does not join subjects; the singular 'CEO' controls the verb.

other_examples.sentence: The director, together with the producers, has approved the script.
other_examples.translation: Sutradara, bersama para produser, telah menyetujui naskahnya.

explanation.en: The subject 'The director' is singular, so the verb is 'has'.
explanation.id: Subjek 'The director' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'.

questions.question: Mathematics ___ always been my weakest subject.
questions.explanation: 'Mathematics' is the name of a subject and is grammatically singular, so the verb is 'has'.

subtopic.id: Subjek Tunggal dan Jamak (Kata Benda Khusus)

description.en: Names of academic subjects ending in -s (mathematics, physics, economics, linguistics) are singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Nama mata pelajaran yang berakhiran -s (mathematics, physics, economics, linguistics) bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Mathematics have always been my weakest subject.
wrong_correct.correct: Mathematics has always been my weakest subject.

explanation.en: 'Mathematics' names one field of study, so it is singular despite the final -s.
explanation.id: 'Mathematics' menamai satu bidang studi, sehingga bersifat tunggal meskipun berakhiran -s.

en.introduction: A group of nouns ending in -s refers to a single discipline or a single concept, so they behave like singular nouns.

rules.title: 1. School Subjects Are Singular
rules.explanation: Mathematics, physics, economics, statistics (as a subject), linguistics, and athletics take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Subject name + singular verb
notes: Physics is difficult.
Economics has become popular.

rules.title: 2. But Some -s Nouns Are Plural
rules.explanation: Words like scissors, glasses, trousers, and clothes are always plural and need plural verbs.
rules.structure: Plural-only noun + plural verb
notes: The scissors are on the table.
My glasses were broken.

common_mistakes.wrong: Physics are my favourite subject.
common_mistakes.correct: Physics is my favourite subject.
common_mistakes.reason: A school subject name is singular, so it takes 'is'.

other_examples.sentence: Economics is offered as an elective in this school.
other_examples.translation: Ekonomi ditawarkan sebagai mata pelajaran pilihan di sekolah ini.

explanation.en: 'Economics' refers to one subject, so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.id: 'Economics' merujuk pada satu mata pelajaran, sehingga kata kerjanya 'is'.

questions.question: The news about the earthquake ___ very disturbing.
questions.explanation: 'News' is an uncountable singular noun despite ending in -s, so the verb is 'is'.

subtopic.id: Kata Benda Tak Terhitung dan Khusus

description.en: 'News' is an uncountable singular noun. It always takes a singular verb, even with modifiers after it.
description.id: 'News' adalah kata benda tunggal tak terhitung. Kata ini selalu memakai kata kerja tunggal, bahkan dengan pewatas setelahnya.

wrong_correct.wrong: The news about the earthquake are very disturbing.
wrong_correct.correct: The news about the earthquake is very disturbing.

explanation.en: 'News' ends in -s but is singular, and 'about the earthquake' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: 'News' berakhiran -s tetapi bersifat tunggal, dan 'about the earthquake' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: A few English nouns look plural because of a final -s but are actually singular. 'News' is the most common example in exams.

rules.title: 1. News Is Singular
rules.explanation: 'News' has no plural form and always takes a singular verb.
rules.structure: The news + singular verb
notes: The news is good.
The news was shocking.

rules.title: 2. Modifiers Do Not Change It
rules.explanation: A phrase like 'about the earthquake' or 'from Jakarta' only describes the news, so the verb stays singular.
rules.structure: The news + (modifier) + singular verb
notes: The news from the capital is worrying.

common_mistakes.wrong: The news were announced this morning.
common_mistakes.correct: The news was announced this morning.
common_mistakes.reason: 'News' is singular and requires 'was'.

other_examples.sentence: The news from the front line is not good.
other_examples.translation: Kabar dari garis depan tidak baik.

explanation.en: Despite ending in -s, 'news' is singular and takes 'is'.
explanation.id: Meskipun berakhiran -s, 'news' bersifat tunggal dan memakai 'is'.

questions.question: Measles ___ a highly contagious disease.
questions.explanation: 'Measles' is the name of one disease and is grammatically singular, so the verb is 'is'.

subtopic.id: Subjek Tunggal dan Jamak (Kata Benda Khusus)

description.en: Names of diseases ending in -s, such as measles, mumps, and rabies, are singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Nama penyakit yang berakhiran -s, seperti measles, mumps, dan rabies, bersifat tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Measles are a highly contagious disease.
wrong_correct.correct: Measles is a highly contagious disease.

explanation.en: 'Measles' names one disease, so it is singular in grammar.
explanation.id: 'Measles' menamai satu penyakit, sehingga bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal.

en.introduction: Some nouns end in -s because of their history, not because they are plural. Disease names are a common example in grammar tests.

rules.title: 1. Disease Names Are Singular
rules.explanation: Measles, mumps, rabies, and rickets all take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Disease name + singular verb
notes: Measles is common among children.
Mumps is caused by a virus.

rules.title: 2. Do Not Be Misled by the -s
rules.explanation: Always check the meaning of the noun, not just its ending, before choosing the verb form.
rules.structure: Singular concept + singular verb
notes: Compare: 'The glasses are broken' (plural object).

common_mistakes.wrong: Mumps are a painful illness.
common_mistakes.correct: Mumps is a painful illness.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Mumps' is a singular disease name and takes 'is'.

other_examples.sentence: Rabies is a fatal disease if untreated.
other_examples.translation: Rabies adalah penyakit mematikan jika tidak diobati.

explanation.en: 'Rabies' is singular, so the verb is 'is'.
explanation.id: 'Rabies' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'is'.

questions.question: Everybody who wants to participate ___ to register before Monday.
questions.explanation: 'Everybody' is singular, so the main verb must be 'needs'. The relative clause 'who wants to participate' does not change the subject.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Everyone, Everybody, Somebody)

description.en: Indefinite pronouns ending in -body are singular. A relative clause that follows them does not change the number of the main verb.
description.id: Kata ganti tak tentu berakhiran -body bersifat tunggal. Klausa relatif yang mengikutinya tidak mengubah jumlah kata kerja utama.

wrong_correct.wrong: Everybody who wants to participate need to register before Monday.
wrong_correct.correct: Everybody who wants to participate needs to register before Monday.

explanation.en: 'Everybody' is the subject of 'needs'; it is singular, so the verb must be 'needs'.
explanation.id: 'Everybody' adalah subjek dari 'needs'; bentuknya tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'needs'.

en.introduction: A relative clause such as 'who wants to participate' comes between the subject and the main verb. It describes the subject but does not change its number.

rules.title: 1. Find the Main Subject
rules.explanation: The subject of the main verb is 'Everybody'. The clause 'who wants to participate' only describes it.
rules.structure: Everybody + (relative clause) + singular verb
notes: Everybody ... needs to register.
The verb inside the relative clause also agrees with its own subject: 'who wants'.

rules.title: 2. Two Verbs, Two Agreements
rules.explanation: Check each verb separately: 'who' refers to everybody (singular), and 'everybody' is also singular, so both verbs take -s.
rules.structure: Singular subject + singular verb + singular verb
notes: Everybody who wants ... needs ...

common_mistakes.wrong: Everyone who attend the meeting receive a certificate.
common_mistakes.correct: Everyone who attends the meeting receives a certificate.
common_mistakes.reason: Both verbs need the singular -s form because their subjects are singular.

other_examples.sentence: Anyone who owns a dog must register it.
other_examples.translation: Siapa pun yang memelihara anjing harus mendaftarkannya.

explanation.en: 'Anyone' is singular, so both 'owns' and 'must' follow the singular pattern.
explanation.id: 'Anyone' bersifat tunggal, sehingga 'owns' dan 'must' mengikuti pola tunggal.

questions.question: Nobody in the group ___ willing to take responsibility for the mistake.
questions.explanation: 'Nobody' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so the verb must be singular: 'Nobody in the group was willing'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Nobody, None, Nothing)

description.en: Negative indefinite pronouns such as nobody, no one, and nothing are grammatically singular and take singular verbs.
description.id: Kata ganti tak tentu negatif seperti nobody, no one, dan nothing bersifat tunggal secara gramatikal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Nobody in the group were willing to take responsibility for the mistake.
wrong_correct.correct: Nobody in the group was willing to take responsibility for the mistake.

explanation.en: 'Nobody' means 'not one person' and is singular; the phrase 'in the group' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: 'Nobody' berarti 'tidak seorang pun' dan bersifat tunggal; frasa 'in the group' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: Pronouns beginning with 'no-' are always singular, even when they refer to a large group of people.

rules.title: 1. No- Pronouns Are Singular
rules.explanation: Nobody, no one, nothing, and none (in formal usage with countable nouns) take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Nobody / No one / Nothing + singular verb
notes: Nobody knows.
Nothing was found.

rules.title: 2. Prepositional Phrases Do Not Count
rules.explanation: Phrases such as 'in the group', 'of the students', and 'at the party' do not change the subject.
rules.structure: Nobody + (prepositional phrase) + singular verb
notes: Nobody at the party was dancing.

common_mistakes.wrong: No one in the class have finished yet.
common_mistakes.correct: No one in the class has finished yet.
common_mistakes.reason: 'No one' is singular and needs 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: Nothing in the report explains the sudden change.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada apa pun dalam laporan itu yang menjelaskan perubahan mendadak tersebut.

explanation.en: 'Nothing' is singular, so the verb is 'explains'.
explanation.id: 'Nothing' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'explains'.

questions.question: Few of the participants ___ aware of the change in schedule.
questions.explanation: 'Few of' refers to a plural countable noun ('participants'), so the verb must be plural: 'were'.

description.en: Quantifiers that refer to plural countable nouns (few, many, several, both) take plural verbs.
description.id: Pembilang yang merujuk pada kata benda jamak terhitung (few, many, several, both) memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: Few of the participants was aware of the change in schedule.
wrong_correct.correct: Few of the participants were aware of the change in schedule.

explanation.en: 'Few of' always refers to more than one countable item, so the verb is plural.
explanation.id: 'Few of' selalu merujuk pada lebih dari satu benda terhitung, sehingga kata kerjanya jamak.

en.introduction: 'Few' means 'not many'. Because it refers to several individual items, it behaves like a plural subject.

rules.title: 1. Plural Quantifiers
rules.explanation: Few, a few, many, several, and both all take plural verbs.
rules.structure: Few / Many / Several / Both + of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: Few of them were present.
Many of the students have left.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with 'A Little' and 'Much'
rules.explanation: Quantifiers used with uncountable nouns (little, a little, much) take singular verbs.
rules.structure: Little / Much + of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: Little of the information was useful.

common_mistakes.wrong: Several of the players was injured.
common_mistakes.correct: Several of the players were injured.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Several' is always plural and needs a plural verb.

other_examples.sentence: Many of the applicants have already been interviewed.
other_examples.translation: Banyak pelamar telah diwawancarai.

explanation.en: 'Many of' takes a plural verb because it refers to several countable people.
explanation.id: 'Many of' memakai kata kerja jamak karena merujuk pada beberapa orang terhitung.

questions.question: Several of the paintings in the gallery ___ damaged during the storm.
questions.explanation: 'Several of' refers to a plural noun, 'paintings', so the verb must be plural: 'were'.

description.en: 'Several of' always refers to more than two countable items and therefore takes a plural verb.
description.id: 'Several of' selalu merujuk pada lebih dari dua benda terhitung dan karena itu memakai kata kerja jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: Several of the paintings in the gallery was damaged during the storm.
wrong_correct.correct: Several of the paintings in the gallery were damaged during the storm.

explanation.en: 'Paintings' is plural, and 'in the gallery' is only a modifier, so the plural verb 'were' is required.
explanation.id: 'Paintings' bersifat jamak, dan 'in the gallery' hanya pewatas, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'were' diperlukan.

en.introduction: 'Several' means more than two but not many. It always refers to countable items, so it is grammatically plural.

rules.title: 1. Several Is Always Plural
rules.explanation: Whether it appears alone or in 'several of', it takes a plural verb.
rules.structure: Several (of + plural noun) + plural verb
notes: Several people were waiting.
Several of the books have been sold.

rules.title: 2. Ignore the Interrupting Phrase
rules.explanation: Phrases such as 'in the gallery' sit between the subject and the verb but do not affect agreement.
rules.structure: Several of + plural noun + (phrase) + plural verb
notes: The modifier 'in the gallery' can be removed without changing the verb.

common_mistakes.wrong: Several of the houses was flooded.
common_mistakes.correct: Several of the houses were flooded.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Several of' is plural and requires 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: Several of the documents were missing from the file.
other_examples.translation: Beberapa dokumen hilang dari berkas itu.

explanation.en: 'Several of' takes a plural verb, here 'were'.
explanation.id: 'Several of' memakai kata kerja jamak, dalam hal ini 'were'.

questions.question: Every boy and every girl in the village ___ given a free health check-up.
questions.explanation: When 'every' or 'each' is repeated before each noun joined by 'and', the subject is singular, so the verb is 'was'.

description.en: When 'each' or 'every' is used before both nouns joined by 'and', the subject is considered singular.
description.id: Ketika 'each' atau 'every' dipakai sebelum kedua kata benda yang digabungkan dengan 'and', subjeknya dianggap tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Every boy and every girl in the village were given a free health check-up.
wrong_correct.correct: Every boy and every girl in the village was given a free health check-up.

explanation.en: The repeated 'every' makes the subject singular, so the singular verb 'was' is required.
explanation.id: Pengulangan 'every' membuat subjek bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'was' diperlukan.

en.introduction: Normally 'and' produces a plural subject. However, when 'each' or 'every' comes before both nouns, the sentence emphasises each individual separately, so the subject is singular.

rules.title: 1. Each ... and Each / Every ... and Every = Singular
rules.explanation: The repetition of the determiner turns the whole subject into a singular idea.
rules.structure: Every + noun + and + every + noun + singular verb
notes: Every student and every teacher was invited.
Each boy and each girl has a book.

rules.title: 2. Compare with Plain 'And'
rules.explanation: Without the repeated determiners, the subject is plural.
rules.structure: Noun + and + noun + plural verb
notes: The boy and the girl were given check-ups.

common_mistakes.wrong: Each member and each guest were welcomed.
common_mistakes.correct: Each member and each guest was welcomed.
common_mistakes.reason: The repeated 'each' makes the subject singular.

other_examples.sentence: Every room and every corridor has been cleaned.
other_examples.translation: Setiap kamar dan setiap koridor telah dibersihkan.

explanation.en: The repeated 'every' makes the subject singular, so the verb is 'has been'.
explanation.id: Pengulangan 'every' membuat subjek tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has been'.

questions.question: The government ___ announced its new education policy.
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'its' shows that 'the government' is treated as one unit, so the singular verb 'has' is used.

description.en: In standard English, 'government' is usually treated as a single body and takes a singular verb, especially when followed by 'its'.
description.id: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku, 'government' biasanya dianggap satu badan dan memakai kata kerja tunggal, terutama bila diikuti 'its'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The government have announced its new education policy.
wrong_correct.correct: The government has announced its new education policy.

explanation.en: The singular pronoun 'its' requires a singular verb, so 'has' is correct.
explanation.id: Kata ganti tunggal 'its' memerlukan kata kerja tunggal, sehingga 'has' yang benar.

en.introduction: 'Government' is a collective noun. When it refers to the institution as a whole, it takes a singular verb. The pronoun 'its' confirms this singular view.

rules.title: 1. Government as an Institution = Singular
rules.explanation: Most standard usage treats 'the government' as a single body that decides and acts.
rules.structure: The government + singular verb + its
notes: The government has approved the budget.
The government is planning new regulations.

rules.title: 2. Keep Pronouns Consistent
rules.explanation: If you use a singular verb, use 'it' or 'its' later in the sentence.
rules.structure: Singular verb + it / its
notes: Correct: has ... its
Incorrect: have ... its

common_mistakes.wrong: The government are changing its policy.
common_mistakes.correct: The government is changing its policy.
common_mistakes.reason: The singular pronoun 'its' requires a singular verb.

other_examples.sentence: The company has increased its production this year.
other_examples.translation: Perusahaan itu telah meningkatkan produksinya tahun ini.

explanation.en: 'The company' acts as one unit and is referred to by 'its', so the verb is 'has'.
explanation.id: 'The company' bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan dan dirujuk dengan 'its', sehingga kata kerjanya 'has'.

questions.question: A flock of birds ___ flying over the rice field when we arrived.
questions.explanation: The head noun is 'flock' (singular). 'Of birds' is only a prepositional phrase, so the verb is 'was'.

description.en: Collective nouns that name a group of animals or things (a flock of, a herd of, a bunch of, a pack of) take a singular verb when the group is seen as one unit.
description.id: Kata benda kolektif yang menamai sekelompok hewan atau benda (a flock of, a herd of, a bunch of, a pack of) memakai kata kerja tunggal bila kelompok dilihat sebagai satu kesatuan.

wrong_correct.wrong: A flock of birds were flying over the rice field when we arrived.
wrong_correct.correct: A flock of birds was flying over the rice field when we arrived.

explanation.en: The subject is 'A flock' (singular); 'of birds' describes the flock but does not control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'A flock' (tunggal); 'of birds' menjelaskan kawanan itu tetapi tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: Expressions of the form 'a group of + plural noun' take a singular verb because the head noun is the group word.

rules.title: 1. Group Word Is the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Words such as flock, herd, bunch, pack, crowd, and collection are singular.
rules.structure: A flock / herd / bunch / pack + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: A herd of cattle was grazing.
A bunch of grapes is on the table.

rules.title: 2. Contrast with 'The Number Of' Patterns
rules.explanation: In these expressions the plural noun after 'of' is never the subject, so it cannot make the verb plural.
rules.structure: A + group noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: A crowd of people was waiting outside.

common_mistakes.wrong: A pack of wolves were howling in the distance.
common_mistakes.correct: A pack of wolves was howling in the distance.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'pack' is singular, so the verb must be singular.

other_examples.sentence: A herd of elephants was crossing the road.
other_examples.translation: Sekawanan gajah sedang menyeberangi jalan.

explanation.en: The singular head noun 'herd' controls the verb, so 'was' is correct.
explanation.id: Inti subjek tunggal 'herd' menentukan kata kerja, sehingga 'was' benar.

questions.question: Half of the cake ___ eaten before the guests arrived.
questions.explanation: With 'half of', the verb agrees with the noun after 'of'. 'Cake' is uncountable and singular, so the verb is 'was'.

subtopic.en: Fractions and Quantifiers (Half of, Two-thirds of)
subtopic.id: Pecahan dan Pembilang (Half of, Two-thirds of)

description.en: With fractions and expressions such as 'half of', 'a third of', and 'two-thirds of', the verb agrees with the noun that follows 'of'.
description.id: Dengan pecahan dan ungkapan seperti 'half of', 'a third of', dan 'two-thirds of', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of'.

wrong_correct.wrong: Half of the cake were eaten before the guests arrived.
wrong_correct.correct: Half of the cake was eaten before the guests arrived.

explanation.en: 'Cake' is uncountable in this sentence, so the verb must be singular: 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Cake' bersifat tak terhitung dalam kalimat ini, sehingga kata kerjanya harus tunggal: 'was'.

en.introduction: Fractions such as 'half of' and 'two-thirds of' are not the subject themselves; they take their number from the noun after 'of'.

rules.title: 1. Check the Noun After Of
rules.explanation: Uncountable and singular nouns take singular verbs; plural nouns take plural verbs.
rules.structure: Half of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: Half of the cake was eaten.
Half of the students were absent.

rules.title: 2. The Same Rule for All Fractions
rules.explanation: 'A quarter of', 'a third of', 'two-thirds of', and 'most of' behave in exactly the same way.
rules.structure: Fraction + of + noun + verb (agrees with noun)
notes: Two-thirds of the land is forest.
Two-thirds of the players were tired.

common_mistakes.wrong: Half of the money were lost.
common_mistakes.correct: Half of the money was lost.
