common_mistakes.reason: 'Money' is uncountable and singular, so the verb must be 'was'.

other_examples.sentence: A third of the water has evaporated.
other_examples.translation: Sepertiga air telah menguap.

explanation.en: 'Water' is uncountable, so the verb is singular: 'has'.
explanation.id: 'Water' bersifat tak terhitung, sehingga kata kerjanya tunggal: 'has'.

questions.question: Two-thirds of the students in that school ___ passed the national exam.
questions.explanation: The noun after 'of' is 'students' (plural), so the verb must be plural: 'have passed'.

subtopic.en: Fractions and Quantifiers (Half of, Two-thirds of)
subtopic.id: Pecahan dan Pembilang (Half of, Two-thirds of)

description.en: With fractions, the verb agrees with the noun after 'of', not with the fraction itself.
description.id: Dengan pecahan, kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of', bukan dengan pecahannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Two-thirds of the students in that school has passed the national exam.
wrong_correct.correct: Two-thirds of the students in that school have passed the national exam.

explanation.en: 'Students' is plural, so the plural verb 'have' is needed. The phrase 'in that school' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: 'Students' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have' diperlukan. Frasa 'in that school' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: A fraction like 'two-thirds of' is a quantifier. The real subject is the noun that follows, and that noun decides the verb form.

rules.title: 1. Plural Noun After Of = Plural Verb
rules.explanation: Countable plural nouns take plural verbs after fractions and quantifiers.
rules.structure: Fraction + of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: Two-thirds of the students have passed.
Half of the books were damaged.

rules.title: 2. Watch Out for Interrupting Phrases
rules.explanation: Phrases like 'in that school' come after the noun but do not change the agreement.
rules.structure: Fraction + of + noun + (phrase) + verb
notes: 'In that school' can be removed without affecting the verb.

common_mistakes.wrong: Most of the homework have been corrected.
common_mistakes.correct: Most of the homework has been corrected.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Homework' is uncountable, so the singular verb 'has' is required.

other_examples.sentence: Half of the members have already voted.
other_examples.translation: Setengah dari anggota telah memberikan suara.

explanation.en: 'Members' is plural, so the plural verb 'have' is correct.
explanation.id: 'Members' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'have' benar.

questions.question: None of the money ___ spent on unnecessary items.
questions.explanation: 'Money' is an uncountable noun, so the verb after 'none of' must be singular: 'None of the money was spent'.

description.en: With 'none of', the verb agrees with the noun after 'of'. Uncountable nouns take singular verbs.
description.id: Dengan 'none of', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan kata benda setelah 'of'. Kata benda tak terhitung memakai kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: None of the money were spent on unnecessary items.
wrong_correct.correct: None of the money was spent on unnecessary items.

explanation.en: 'Money' is uncountable and singular, so the verb must be 'was'.
explanation.id: 'Money' bersifat tak terhitung dan tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'was'.

en.introduction: 'None of' takes its number from the noun that follows. With uncountable nouns it is always singular.

rules.title: 1. None Of + Uncountable = Singular
rules.explanation: Nouns such as money, water, information, and time are uncountable and require a singular verb.
rules.structure: None of + uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: None of the money was wasted.
None of the information was accurate.

rules.title: 2. None Of + Plural Noun
rules.explanation: With plural countable nouns, both singular and plural verbs occur; formal writing commonly uses the singular.
rules.structure: None of + plural noun + singular or plural verb
notes: None of the students was late. (formal)
None of the students were late. (also accepted)

common_mistakes.wrong: None of the equipment are working.
common_mistakes.correct: None of the equipment is working.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Equipment' is uncountable, so the verb must be singular.

other_examples.sentence: None of the water has been wasted.
other_examples.translation: Tidak ada air yang terbuang.

explanation.en: 'Water' is uncountable, so the singular verb 'has' is used.
explanation.id: 'Water' bersifat tak terhitung, sehingga kata kerja tunggal 'has' digunakan.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: The list of items have been sent to the supplier.
questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'list' (singular). 'Of items' is only a prepositional phrase, so the verb must be 'has been sent'.

description.en: In the pattern 'the list of + plural noun', the head noun 'list' controls the verb, so a singular verb is required.
description.id: Dalam pola 'the list of + kata benda jamak', inti subjek 'list' menentukan kata kerja, sehingga kata kerja tunggal diperlukan.

wrong_correct.wrong: The list of items have been sent to the supplier.
wrong_correct.correct: The list of items has been sent to the supplier.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The list', which is singular, so the verb must be 'has been sent'.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The list' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has been sent'.

en.introduction: When a singular noun such as list, group, box, or set is followed by 'of + plural noun', the verb agrees with the first noun.

rules.title: 1. The First Noun Is the Subject
rules.explanation: Words like list, box, set, and group are the grammatical head of the subject.
rules.structure: The list / box / set + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The list of names has been updated.
The box of chocolates is on the table.

rules.title: 2. Cover the 'of' Phrase
rules.explanation: Read only the beginning and the verb; that makes the correct agreement obvious.
rules.structure: The list ... has been sent.
notes: This quick test prevents most errors of this type.

common_mistakes.wrong: The set of instructions are confusing.
common_mistakes.correct: The set of instructions is confusing.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'set' is singular, so the verb must be 'is'.

other_examples.sentence: The box of old photographs was found in the attic.
other_examples.translation: Kotak berisi foto-foto lama itu ditemukan di loteng.

explanation.en: The head noun 'box' is singular, so the verb is 'was'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'box' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'was'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: Each of the players have received a new jersey.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is a singular indefinite pronoun, so the verb must be 'has received'.

subtopic.id: Kata Ganti Tak Tentu (Each, Every, Everyone)

description.en: 'Each of + plural noun' is a singular subject and requires a singular verb.
description.id: 'Each of + kata benda jamak' adalah subjek tunggal dan memerlukan kata kerja tunggal.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the players have received a new jersey.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the players has received a new jersey.

explanation.en: The head of the subject is 'Each', which is singular, so 'has received' is correct.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'Each' yang bersifat tunggal, sehingga 'has received' yang benar.

en.introduction: This is a classic exam error. The plural noun right before the verb tempts the writer to use a plural verb, but the true subject is 'each'.

rules.title: 1. Each Is Always Singular
rules.explanation: Regardless of how many items follow, 'each' takes a singular verb.
rules.structure: Each of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the players has received a jersey.
Each of the houses has a garden.

rules.title: 2. The Noun After Of Is Not the Subject
rules.explanation: 'Of the players' is a prepositional phrase; it describes the group but does not control the verb.
rules.structure: Each + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Remove 'of the players' and you get 'Each ... has received'.

common_mistakes.wrong: Each of the books have a red cover.
common_mistakes.correct: Each of the books has a red cover.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Each' is singular and requires 'has'.

other_examples.sentence: Each of the employees has signed the contract.
other_examples.translation: Setiap karyawan telah menandatangani kontrak.

explanation.en: 'Each' is singular, so the verb is 'has signed'.
explanation.id: 'Each' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has signed'.

questions.sentence: Neither the driver nor the passengers was injured in the accident.
tokens: Neither the driver nor the passengers
questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The passengers' is plural, so the verb must be 'were injured'.

description.en: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.
description.id: Dengan 'neither ... nor', kata kerja menyesuaikan dengan subjek yang paling dekat dengannya.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither the driver nor the passengers was injured in the accident.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither the driver nor the passengers were injured in the accident.

explanation.en: The subject closest to the verb is 'the passengers' (plural), so 'were injured' is required.
explanation.id: Subjek yang paling dekat dengan kata kerja adalah 'the passengers' (jamak), sehingga 'were injured' diperlukan.

en.introduction: The proximity rule applies here. Even though 'the driver' is singular and comes first, the verb follows the second subject.

rules.title: 1. Match the Second Subject
rules.explanation: Identify the noun directly before the verb and make the verb agree with it.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the driver nor the passengers were...
Neither the passengers nor the driver was...

rules.title: 2. Keep the Passive Form Correct
rules.explanation: In the passive voice, only the auxiliary changes: 'was injured' becomes 'were injured'.
rules.structure: be + past participle
notes: Both sentences are correct; the subject order decides the verb.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the teacher nor the students was ready.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearer subject 'students' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the manager nor the workers were informed about the change.
other_examples.translation: Baik manajer maupun para pekerja tidak diberi tahu tentang perubahan itu.

explanation.en: The nearer subject 'workers' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek yang lebih dekat, 'workers', bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect part of the sentence and type the correct form.
questions.sentence: The members of the committee is meeting today to discuss the budget.
questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'members' (plural). 'Of the committee' is only a prepositional phrase, so the verb must be 'are meeting'.

description.en: In 'the members of the committee', the head noun is the plural 'members', not the singular collective noun 'committee'.
description.id: Dalam 'the members of the committee', inti subjeknya adalah 'members' yang jamak, bukan kata benda kolektif tunggal 'committee'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The members of the committee is meeting today to discuss the budget.
wrong_correct.correct: The members of the committee are meeting today to discuss the budget.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The members' (plural). The word 'committee' is inside a prepositional phrase and cannot control the verb.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The members' (jamak). Kata 'committee' berada di dalam frasa preposisi dan tidak menentukan kata kerja.

en.introduction: Be careful with expressions like 'the members of the committee'. The collective noun appears last, but the subject is the plural word 'members'.

rules.title: 1. Plural Head Noun = Plural Verb
rules.explanation: Words such as members, staff members, players, and employees are plural and take plural verbs.
rules.structure: The members / players / employees + of + group noun + plural verb
notes: The members of the committee are meeting.
The players of the team were tired.

rules.title: 2. Compare with the Collective Noun Alone
rules.explanation: When the collective noun is the whole subject, it can be singular; when a plural noun heads the phrase, the verb is plural.
rules.structure: The committee is... / The members of the committee are...
notes: The committee is meeting today.
The members of the committee are meeting today.

common_mistakes.wrong: The players of the national team was awarded a prize.
common_mistakes.correct: The players of the national team were awarded a prize.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'players' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.

other_examples.sentence: The employees of the company are demanding higher wages.
other_examples.translation: Para karyawan perusahaan itu menuntut upah yang lebih tinggi.

explanation.en: The head noun 'employees' is plural, so the verb is 'are'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'employees' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'are'.

questions.passage: The library at our school ___ (i) ___ open from Monday to Saturday. Students who borrow books ___ (ii) ___ to return them within two weeks. Neither the librarian nor the assistants ___ (iii) ___ allowed to accept late returns without a fine.
questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.explanation: The head noun 'library' is singular (is); 'students' is plural (are required); with 'neither ... nor' the nearer subject 'assistants' is plural (are allowed).

description.en: In longer texts, several agreement rules may appear together: head nouns with prepositional phrases, plural subjects, and the proximity rule with 'neither ... nor'.
description.id: Dalam teks yang lebih panjang, beberapa aturan kesesuaian dapat muncul bersamaan: inti subjek dengan frasa preposisi, subjek jamak, dan aturan kedekatan dengan 'neither ... nor'.

wrong_correct.wrong: The library at our school are open from Monday to Saturday.
wrong_correct.correct: The library at our school is open from Monday to Saturday.

explanation.en: The head noun 'library' is singular; 'at our school' is a prepositional phrase.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'library' bersifat tunggal; 'at our school' adalah frasa preposisi.

en.introduction: This passage tests three different agreement rules at once. Work through each blank separately.

rules.title: 1. Blank (i): Singular Head Noun
rules.explanation: The subject is 'The library at our school'. The head noun 'library' is singular, so the verb is 'is'.
rules.structure: The library + (prepositional phrase) + is
notes: The plural noun 'school' does not affect the verb.

rules.title: 2. Blank (ii): Plural Subject
rules.explanation: The subject is 'Students who borrow books'. The head noun 'students' is plural, so the verb is 'are required'.
rules.structure: Students + (relative clause) + plural verb
notes: The relative clause 'who borrow books' describes the students.

rules.title: 3. Blank (iii): Proximity Rule
rules.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'the assistants', which is plural, so 'are allowed' is correct.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: 'The assistants' is the nearest subject and it is plural.

common_mistakes.wrong: Choosing one verb form for all three blanks.
common_mistakes.correct: Check each blank separately using its own subject.
common_mistakes.reason: Different clauses in the same passage can follow different agreement rules.

other_examples.sentence: The museum in those towns is open daily, and neither the guards nor the guides are allowed to smoke inside.
other_examples.translation: Museum di kota-kota itu buka setiap hari, dan baik penjaga maupun pemandu tidak diperbolehkan merokok di dalam.

explanation.en: The singular head noun 'museum' takes 'is', and the nearer subject 'guides' takes 'are'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek tunggal 'museum' memakai 'is', dan subjek terdekat 'guides' memakai 'are'.

questions.passage: The committee ___ (i) ___ already reached its decision about the new budget. Each of the members ___ (ii) ___ prepared a short report. Unfortunately, neither the chairman nor the treasurer ___ (iii) ___ able to attend the final meeting.
questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.explanation: The committee acts as a unit with 'its' (has); 'each of' is singular (has); with 'neither ... nor' the nearer subject 'the treasurer' is singular (was).

description.en: This passage combines collective nouns, indefinite pronouns, and correlative conjunctions, all of which affect subject-verb agreement.
description.id: Bacaan ini menggabungkan kata benda kolektif, kata ganti tak tentu, dan konjungsi korelatif, yang semuanya memengaruhi kesesuaian subjek dan kata kerja.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the members have prepared a short report.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the members has prepared a short report.

explanation.en: 'Each' is the singular head of the subject, so the verb must be 'has'.
explanation.id: 'Each' adalah inti subjek yang tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has'.

en.introduction: Each blank follows a different rule. Identify the exact subject for each blank before choosing the verb.

rules.title: 1. Blank (i): Collective Noun as a Unit
rules.explanation: The pronoun 'its' shows that 'the committee' is treated as one body, so the verb is 'has'.
rules.structure: The committee + singular verb + its
notes: The committee has reached its decision.

rules.title: 2. Blank (ii): Each Of = Singular
rules.explanation: The subject is 'Each of the members'. The head word 'each' is singular, so the verb is 'has'.
rules.structure: Each of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the members has prepared a report.

rules.title: 3. Blank (iii): Proximity with Neither... Nor
rules.explanation: The nearer subject is 'the treasurer' (singular), so the verb is 'was'.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the chairman nor the treasurer was able to attend.

common_mistakes.wrong: Assuming all three blanks need the same form.
common_mistakes.correct: Test each subject separately before choosing a verb.
common_mistakes.reason: The three clauses follow three different agreement rules.

other_examples.sentence: The board has approved its plan, and each of the directors has signed the document.
other_examples.translation: Dewan telah menyetujui rencananya, dan setiap direktur telah menandatangani dokumen itu.

explanation.en: 'The board' is a unit (has), and 'each of' is singular (has).
explanation.id: 'The board' adalah satu kesatuan (has), dan 'each of' bersifat tunggal (has).

questions.passage: Traffic in big cities ___ (i) ___ a serious problem. A number of commuters ___ (ii) ___ forced to spend hours on the road every day. The government, together with local authorities, ___ (iii) ___ trying to improve public transport.
questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.explanation: 'Traffic' is uncountable singular (is); 'a number of' means several (are); 'together with' does not change the singular subject 'the government' (is).

description.en: This passage tests uncountable nouns, the 'a number of' pattern, and interrupting phrases with 'together with'.
description.id: Bacaan ini menguji kata benda tak terhitung, pola 'a number of', dan frasa penyela dengan 'together with'.

wrong_correct.wrong: A number of commuters is forced to spend hours on the road every day.
wrong_correct.correct: A number of commuters are forced to spend hours on the road every day.

explanation.en: 'A number of' means 'several', so the verb must be plural: 'are'.
explanation.id: 'A number of' berarti 'beberapa', sehingga kata kerjanya harus jamak: 'are'.

en.introduction: Three different agreement situations appear in this short passage. Deal with each blank on its own.

rules.title: 1. Blank (i): Uncountable Noun
rules.explanation: 'Traffic' is uncountable and singular, so the verb is 'is'.
rules.structure: Uncountable noun + singular verb
notes: Traffic is a serious problem.

rules.title: 2. Blank (ii): A Number Of = Plural
rules.explanation: 'A number of commuters' means 'several commuters', so the verb is 'are'.
rules.structure: A number of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: A number of commuters are forced to wait.

rules.title: 3. Blank (iii): Together With = Interrupting Phrase
rules.explanation: The subject is 'The government' (singular); 'together with local authorities' does not make it plural, so the verb is 'is'.
rules.structure: Singular subject + , together with + phrase, + singular verb
notes: The government is trying to improve public transport.

common_mistakes.wrong: The government, together with local authorities, are trying to improve public transport.
common_mistakes.correct: The government, together with local authorities, is trying to improve public transport.
common_mistakes.reason: 'Together with' is not 'and'; the singular subject 'the government' controls the verb.

other_examples.sentence: A number of tourists are visiting the temple, and the temple, together with its gardens, is well maintained.
other_examples.translation: Sejumlah wisatawan mengunjungi candi itu, dan candi itu, bersama taman-tamannya, terawat dengan baik.

explanation.en: 'A number of' takes 'are', while 'together with' leaves the singular subject 'the temple' unchanged.
explanation.id: 'A number of' memakai 'are', sedangkan 'together with' tidak mengubah subjek tunggal 'the temple'.

questions.passage: Rina volunteers at a local animal shelter. Every Saturday, she and her brother ___ (i) ___ at the shelter from morning until noon. They feed the animals and clean the cages. The manager of the shelter ___ (ii) ___ very grateful for their help.
questions.question: Which set of words correctly completes the passage?
questions.explanation: 'She and her brother' is a compound plural subject (work); 'The manager of the shelter' has a singular head noun (is).

description.en: This passage tests compound subjects joined by 'and' and singular head nouns followed by prepositional phrases.
description.id: Bacaan ini menguji subjek gabungan dengan 'and' dan inti subjek tunggal yang diikuti frasa preposisi.

wrong_correct.wrong: Every Saturday, she and her brother works at the shelter from morning until noon.
wrong_correct.correct: Every Saturday, she and her brother work at the shelter from morning until noon.

explanation.en: 'She and her brother' refers to two people, so the plural verb 'work' is required.
explanation.id: 'She and her brother' merujuk pada dua orang, sehingga kata kerja jamak 'work' diperlukan.

en.introduction: Two agreement patterns are tested here: a compound subject with 'and' and a singular head noun with an 'of' phrase.

rules.title: 1. Blank (i): Compound Subject with And
rules.explanation: 'She and her brother' means two people, so the verb is plural: 'work'.
rules.structure: Subject A + and + Subject B + plural verb
notes: She and her brother work at the shelter.
Compare: She works at the shelter.

rules.title: 2. Blank (ii): Singular Head Noun
rules.explanation: The subject is 'The manager of the shelter'. The head noun 'manager' is singular, so the verb is 'is'.
rules.structure: Singular head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The manager of the shelter is grateful.
The noun 'shelter' does not affect the verb.

common_mistakes.wrong: The owner of these shops are very kind.
common_mistakes.correct: The owner of these shops is very kind.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'owner' is singular, so the verb must be 'is'.

other_examples.sentence: My cousin and my neighbour work at the same hospital, and the director of both departments is very strict.
other_examples.translation: Sepupu saya dan tetangga saya bekerja di rumah sakit yang sama, dan direktur kedua departemen itu sangat tegas.

explanation.en: The compound subject takes 'work', and the singular head noun 'director' takes 'is'.
explanation.id: Subjek gabungan memakai 'work', dan inti subjek tunggal 'director' memakai 'is'.

questions.explanation: The head noun of the subject is 'quality' (singular), so the verb must be 'has improved', not 'have improved'.

description.en: In 'the quality of + plural noun', the head noun 'quality' is singular and controls the verb.
description.id: Dalam 'the quality of + kata benda jamak', inti subjek 'quality' bersifat tunggal dan menentukan kata kerja.

wrong_correct.wrong: The quality of the goods have improved since the new manager took over.
wrong_correct.correct: The quality of the goods has improved since the new manager took over.

explanation.en: The subject is 'The quality', a singular noun. The phrase 'of the goods' is only a modifier.
explanation.id: Subjeknya adalah 'The quality', kata benda tunggal. Frasa 'of the goods' hanya pewatas.

en.introduction: This is a very common error in formal writing. The plural noun right before the verb attracts attention, but the real subject comes earlier in the sentence.

rules.title: 1. Locate the Head Noun
rules.explanation: Ask 'What has improved?' The answer is 'the quality', which is singular.
rules.structure: Singular head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The quality of the goods has improved.
The taste of these apples is unusual.

rules.title: 2. Similar Singular Head Nouns
rules.explanation: Words such as quality, amount, level, price, condition, and style are singular and commonly followed by 'of + plural noun'.
rules.structure: Head noun + of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The amount of donations has increased.
The condition of the roads was poor.

common_mistakes.wrong: The level of these rivers have risen.
common_mistakes.correct: The level of these rivers has risen.
common_mistakes.reason: The head noun 'level' is singular.

other_examples.sentence: The condition of the two bridges has deteriorated.
other_examples.translation: Kondisi kedua jembatan itu telah memburuk.

explanation.en: The head noun 'condition' is singular, so the verb is 'has deteriorated'.
explanation.id: Inti subjek 'condition' bersifat tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya 'has deteriorated'.

questions.question: The sentence may contain 0, 1 or multiple errors. Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form. If there is no error, choose No Error.

multiErrorSegments.text: Neither the teacher nor the students

questions.explanation: With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'The students' is plural, so the verb must be 'were aware'.

description.en: With 'neither ... nor', the second subject controls the verb. If the second subject is plural, the verb is plural.
description.id: Dengan 'neither ... nor', subjek kedua menentukan kata kerja. Jika subjek kedua jamak, kata kerjanya jamak.

wrong_correct.wrong: Neither the teacher nor the students was aware of the change in the timetable.
wrong_correct.correct: Neither the teacher nor the students were aware of the change in the timetable.

explanation.en: The subject closest to the verb is 'the students' (plural), so 'were' is required.
explanation.id: Subjek yang paling dekat dengan kata kerja adalah 'the students' (jamak), sehingga 'were' diperlukan.

en.introduction: The proximity rule applies to 'neither ... nor'. The verb follows the subject placed immediately before it.

rules.title: 1. Identify the Nearer Subject
rules.explanation: Look at the noun after 'nor'. That noun determines the verb.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the teacher nor the students were...
Neither the students nor the teacher was...

rules.title: 2. Do Not Use 'And' Logic
rules.explanation: 'Neither ... nor' presents alternatives, not a combined group, so the verb does not automatically become plural.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb matching B
notes: Both orders are correct; only the verb changes.

common_mistakes.wrong: Neither the manager nor the assistants was informed.
common_mistakes.correct: Neither the manager nor the assistants were informed.
common_mistakes.reason: The nearer subject 'assistants' is plural.

other_examples.sentence: Neither the chef nor the waiters were ready when the guests arrived.
other_examples.translation: Baik koki maupun para pelayan belum siap ketika para tamu datang.

explanation.en: The nearer subject 'waiters' is plural, so the verb is 'were'.
explanation.id: Subjek terdekat 'waiters' bersifat jamak, sehingga kata kerjanya 'were'.

questions.question: The sentence may contain 0, 1 or multiple errors. Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form. If there is no error, choose No Error.

multiErrorSegments.text: neither the supervisor nor the assistants

questions.explanation: Two errors: 'Each of ...' is singular, so 'has completed'; and with 'neither ... nor' the nearer subject 'the assistants' is plural, so 'were informed'.

description.en: A single sentence may contain more than one agreement error, each following a different rule.
description.id: Satu kalimat dapat mengandung lebih dari satu kesalahan kesesuaian, masing-masing mengikuti aturan yang berbeda.

wrong_correct.wrong: Each of the volunteers have completed the training, and neither the supervisor nor the assistants was informed about the schedule change.
wrong_correct.correct: Each of the volunteers has completed the training, and neither the supervisor nor the assistants were informed about the schedule change.

explanation.en: The first clause needs 'has completed' because 'each' is singular. The second clause needs 'were informed' because the nearer subject 'the assistants' is plural.
explanation.id: Klausa pertama memerlukan 'has completed' karena 'each' bersifat tunggal. Klausa kedua memerlukan 'were informed' karena subjek terdekat 'the assistants' bersifat jamak.

en.introduction: In long sentences, each clause has its own subject-verb agreement. Check every clause separately instead of applying one rule to the whole sentence.

rules.title: 1. Clause One: Each Of = Singular
rules.explanation: 'Each of the volunteers' has 'each' as its head, so the verb must be 'has completed'.
rules.structure: Each of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: Each of the volunteers has completed the training.

rules.title: 2. Clause Two: Neither... Nor = Proximity
rules.explanation: The subject nearest the verb is 'the assistants' (plural), so the verb must be 'were informed'.
rules.structure: Neither A nor B + verb (agrees with B)
notes: Neither the supervisor nor the assistants were informed.

rules.title: 3. Use 'And' Only for Real Lists
rules.explanation: The word 'and' between the two clauses does not join the subjects. Each clause keeps its own subject and verb.
rules.structure: Clause 1 + , and + Clause 2
notes: Do not let the joining 'and' affect the agreement inside each clause.

common_mistakes.wrong: Correcting only one of the two errors.
common_mistakes.correct: Check every clause for its own agreement problem.
common_mistakes.reason: Long sentences frequently contain more than one agreement error.

other_examples.sentence: Each of the candidates has submitted the form, and neither the clerk nor the officers were available to help.

explanation.en: 'Each of' takes 'has', and 'neither ... nor' with a plural nearer subject takes 'were'.
explanation.id: 'Each of' memakai 'has', dan 'neither ... nor' dengan subjek terdekat jamak memakai 'were'.

questions.explanation: There is no error. 'The number of' is a singular subject, so 'has decreased' is correct.

subtopic.en: Quantity Expressions (The number of / A number of)
subtopic.id: Ungkapan Jumlah (The number of / A number of)

description.en: 'The number of + plural noun' is a singular subject and takes a singular verb, so a sentence using it correctly contains no error.
description.id: 'The number of + kata benda jamak' adalah subjek tunggal dan memakai kata kerja tunggal, sehingga kalimat yang menggunakannya dengan benar tidak mengandung kesalahan.

wrong_correct.wrong: The number of road accidents in the province have decreased significantly this year.
wrong_correct.correct: The number of road accidents in the province has decreased significantly this year.

explanation.en: The head noun is the singular 'number', so the verb must be 'has decreased'. The original sentence already does this correctly.
explanation.id: Inti subjeknya adalah 'number' yang tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya harus 'has decreased'. Kalimat aslinya sudah benar.

en.introduction: Some items in a test deliberately contain no error. You must recognise correct agreement rather than assume an error is always present.

rules.title: 1. The Number Of Is Singular
rules.explanation: The head noun is 'number', so a singular verb is correct.
rules.structure: The number of + plural noun + singular verb
notes: The number of accidents has decreased. (correct)
The number of accidents have decreased. (incorrect)

rules.title: 2. Do Not Confuse It with A Number Of
rules.explanation: 'A number of' means 'several' and is plural, but 'the number of' is singular.
rules.structure: A number of + plural noun + plural verb
notes: A number of accidents have been reported.

common_mistakes.wrong: Marking 'has decreased' as an error because the plural noun 'accidents' appears nearby.
common_mistakes.correct: Recognise that the subject is 'The number', which is singular.
common_mistakes.reason: The plural noun is inside a prepositional phrase and does not control the verb.

other_examples.sentence: The number of tourists visiting the island has risen sharply.
other_examples.translation: Jumlah wisatawan yang mengunjungi pulau itu telah meningkat tajam.

explanation.en: The singular head noun 'number' takes the singular verb 'has risen', so the sentence is correct.
explanation.id: Inti subjek tunggal 'number' memakai kata kerja tunggal 'has risen', sehingga kalimat itu benar.
